summary: Sacks argues ASML's EUV lithography monopoly is the West's single biggest strategic advantage in the AI race, given it is the only source of machines capable of producing leading-edge chips, making it an extremely effective export control — though he acknowledges China's reverse-engineering efforts are a growing risk.
quote: EUV lithography, these machines that are made by ASML, is probably our single biggest advantage in the AI race because they're the only machines that are capable of creating, say, 2 to 3 nanometer chips, semiconductors.
